title: Diagnose successful gateway-backed Claude sessions that never exit
summary: Bounded evidence-only live diagnostic of the reproducible gateway-backed local Claude non-exit: compare the frozen json output shape with stream-json under controlled 10-minute canaries, isolate stdin or tool-set behavior only if needed, preserve fail-closed completion semantics, determine whether a terminal stream event also exposes final-call usage, and propose the smallest later implementation and cross-repo contract scope.
